picks.what_it_is: About 25 to 30 Matchbox Models of Yesteryear, mostly 1980s to 1990s maroon-box and Harrods green-box issues plus Olympic Heritage pictorial boxes; a few loose (Haig bus, fire engine).
Framed Hermannsburg School watercolour, ghost gums and MacDonnell Ranges, signed DESMOND EBATARINJA lower left.
Four framed works: Tallis/Rapkin Van Diemen's Island map c1851, gatehouse watercolour, lake and mountain oil, sepia etching.
picks.drop_reason: No sold comps found or verifiable; common foxed atlas plate plus unattributed decorative works.
